label: pjm 58 seam border
definition: pjm 58 seam-border builds on pjm-57 (measured hydro keeper) and corrects the PJM-NY interchange reference price: exports physically clear at the NYISO Zone A (west) border, not the congestion-inflated system average (Zone J/K import constraints inflate the system-avg by ~10-16%). Same-month WEST/system RT LMP ratios from NYISO zonal data (0.895/0.840/0.790 for 2023/24/25) are applied to the prior system-avg heat rates, lowering the seam HR from 9.66->8.65, 12.92->10.85, 14.67->11.59 (structural mean 13.1->10.4). All coal sigmoids, offer-curve levers, and hydro backfill are pjm-57 verbatim. Determination: NOT-YET — C1 (CC over-run, CT under-run 2023/24) and C2 (2025 gas +7.3%) remain open; C6 unattested.
